ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a single rectangular loop. The left branch has a 5 V voltage source, with polarity labeled as upper terminal “-” and lower terminal “+”. The upper branch has a 7 V voltage source, with polarity labeled as left terminal “-” and right terminal “+”. The right branch is an element labeled 10Ω, with voltage U marked beside it, polarity upper terminal “+” and lower terminal “-”. The bottom is a wire connecting the left and right sides. Reasoning: In the specified direction, starting from the lower-right node, write KVL clockwise around the loop. After going along the bottom wire to the left side, passing upward through the 5 V source is from the “+” terminal to the “-” terminal, so the voltage change is -5 V. Then passing along the top from left to right through the 7 V source is from the “-” terminal to the “+” terminal, so the voltage change is +7 V. Then passing downward through the right-side element, the polarity of U is upper positive and lower negative, and the downward direction is from “+” to “-”, so the voltage change is -U. From KVL: -5 + 7 - U = 0, so U = +2 V.

raw_record.question_text: In the circuit shown in the figure, what is the value of voltage \(U\)?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: a single rectangular loop has a 5 V source on the left labeled - at the upper terminal and + at the lower terminal, a 7 V source on the top labeled - on the left and + on the right, and a right-side element labeled 10 ohm with U measured + at the top and - at the bottom. Traverse clockwise from the bottom-right node: across the bottom wire to the left source, going upward through the 5 V source is from + to -, so the change is -5 V; across the top source left-to-right is from - to +, so the change is +7 V; then down through the right element is from + to -, so the change is -U. Apply KVL: -5 + 7 - U = 0, hence U = +2 V.

推理：按指定方向从右下节点开始顺时针绕回路列 KVL。沿底部导线到左侧后，向上通过 5 V 电源，是从 “+” 端到 “-” 端，因此电压变化为 -5 V。再沿顶部从左到右通过 7 V 电源，是从 “-” 端到 “+” 端，因此电压变化为 +7 V。然后向下通过右侧元件，U 的极性是上正下负，沿向下方向是从 “+” 到 “-”，因此电压变化为 -U。由 KVL 得：-5 + 7 - U = 0，所以 U = +2 V。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the circuit topology as one closed loop containing a left 5 V source with polarity minus at the top and plus at the bottom, a top 7 V source with minus on the left and plus on the right, and a right 10 ohm element whose voltage U is defined plus at the top and minus at the bottom.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text only to identify that the requested quantity is the voltage U in the shown circuit and that the answer should be a voltage value.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use Kirchhoff's Voltage Law: the algebraic sum of voltage changes around a closed loop is zero. Voltage changes are positive when traversing from minus to plus and negative when traversing from plus to minus, matching the labeled polarities.
